Hi Alex — happy to answer these briefly, and we can go deeper in the deep-dive: 

1) Ephemeral tokens: yes — Redwood supports short-lived tokens and a Vault-friendly rotation pattern. Our recommended flow: issue a short-lived service token via Redwood's token-exchange endpoint; store in Vault and configure automatic renewal in your job scheduler. Example snippet included in redwood-auth-quickref.md.

2) Regional routing & fallbacks: you can pin by region (eu-west-1) in routing policies. We also support graded fallback to a compatible quantized variant or lower-tier model; routing policy examples are in the SDK quickstart under "routing_policies.json".

3) Embeddings + rerank latency: for 10k candidates we typically do ANN on the client (FAISS) to narrow to top N=200, then our reranker call adds ~120–250ms depending on model size and batch size. End-to-end (client ANN + rerank) is usually ~200–400ms. We can share benchmark numbers for your dataset size during the deep-dive.

I'll bring a sample Python flow showing token refresh + embedding + rerank in the call.

—Dev
